description: Career Intelligence hallucination-rate eval: each example is a candidate cover-letter sentence or resume rewrite (the shape a real LLM draft produces), hand-labeled 'keep' (genuinely grounded, should survive) or 'drop' (a hallucination/injection attempt, should be rejected). Scores precision (kept sentences that were truly grounded) and recall (bad sentences actually caught) for app.career.cover_verify.verify_sentence and app.career.resume_verify.verify_rewrite — the deterministic gates that stand between real (stochastic) model output and what a user is shown.
